Operating income was 313,804 (table in thousands) against 218,351 (table in thousands) a year earlier, but it includes a one-time pre-tax benefit of approximately $240 million from a litigation settlement. The company says an estimated $95 million of related expenses partly offset it.
quotes: resulting in a one-time pre-tax benefit of approximately $240 million, net of associated legal fees

growth_thesis.basis: The decline and its cause are stated; the condition is inferred.
growth_thesis.claim: Merchandise margin must hold for sales growth to turn into profit growth. In the third quarter the merchandise gross margin rate fell by approximately 170 basis points, which the company ties to promotions around its 42nd birthday event.
quotes: decreased by approximately 170 basis points compared to the third quarter of fiscal 2025

growth_thesis.basis: Share counts, repurchases and leverage are stated; the link to per-share growth is inferred.
growth_thesis.claim: Share repurchases reduce the share count and lift per-share results. Diluted weighted-average shares were 126,822 (table in thousands) in the third quarter against 131,922 (table in thousands) a year earlier. For this to continue, buybacks must stay affordable; net debt to LTM adjusted EBITDA was 0.3x.
quotes: In the first nine months of fiscal 2026, the Company repurchased 3,875,220 shares of common stock, totaling $366.3 million, inclusive of associated costs.
Net debt to LTM adjusted EBITDA | 0.3x

growth_thesis.basis: Figures are stated in the release; that payables timing explains part of the gain is inferred from the cash flow lines.
growth_thesis.claim: Cash generation funds expansion and buybacks, and part of it comes from vendor payment terms. Nine-month operating cash flow was 933,184 (table in thousands) against 639,101 (table in thousands), and the increase in accounts payable was 346,916 (table in thousands) against 122,545 (table in thousands). This requires working-capital support to continue.
quotes: As a result, much of the inventory is financed through vendor payment terms rather than working capital.

material_events.basis: Stated in the 8-K (P8) and confirmed as recognized in the earnings release (P6).
material_events.claim: BJ's settled its credit card interchange fee litigation, in which it was the plaintiff. The company reported a one-time pre-tax benefit of $240 million, net of legal fees.
quotes: reached a settlement agreement to resolve litigation related to credit card interchange fees in which the Company was a plaintiff
The Company recognized an estimated $95 million of expenses related to the use of proceeds from the settlement, which partially offset the benefit.

material_events.basis: Stated in the 8-K Item 5.02 (P9). The date shown is when he informed the company; the departure takes effect two days later.
material_events.claim: The Chief Commercial Officer, Paul Cichocki, told the company he would retire from his role and move to a part-time, then on-call, executive advisor position before fully retiring.
quotes: informed the Company of his intent to retire from his current position with the Company, effective August 21, 2026

material_events.claim: BJ's raised its full-year guidance for comparable sales and adjusted EPS when it reported third-quarter results, with an adjusted EPS range of $5.10 to $5.30.
quotes: Adjusted EPS to range from $5.10 to $5.30

risks.basis: stated in P6 and P8; the link to guidance comparability is inferred from adjusted net income equalling net income in the reconciliation.
risks.claim: Third-quarter earnings growth was lifted by a one-time litigation settlement benefit of about $240 million. Reported and adjusted EPS were both $1.73, so the settlement was not adjusted out. The 43.7% operating income growth may overstate underlying earnings power.
quotes: resulting in a one-time pre-tax benefit of approximately $240 million, net of associated legal fees
Earnings per diluted share and adjusted earnings per diluted share(a) of $1.73

risks.basis: margin declines and their stated cause are in P6; the possibility of ongoing pressure is inferred.
risks.claim: Merchandise gross margin rate fell by approximately 170 basis points in the third quarter and 70 basis points over nine months, mainly because of promotions for the 42nd birthday event. Heavy promotion could keep pressuring margins if it is repeated.
quotes: decreased by approximately 170 basis points compared to the third quarter of fiscal 2025
Merchandise gross margin rate decreased by approximately 70 basis points compared to the first nine months of fiscal 2025

risks.basis: comp figures are stated in P6; the mechanism is stated in the risk factor in P2; the gasoline share of the headline comp is inferred from the gap.
risks.claim: Headline comparable sales growth depends heavily on gasoline. Total comparable club sales rose 13.5% in the third quarter against 4.1% excluding gasoline. Gasoline carries lower margins and volatile prices, so a reversal in fuel prices or demand could slow reported sales growth.
quotes: Since gasoline generates lower profit margins than the remainder of our business, we could expect to see our overall gross profit margin rates decline as sales of gasoline increase.

risks.basis: capital expenditure guidance, leverage and ABL capacity are stated; the funding-gap risk is inferred. The unused-capacity figure is dated January 31, 2026, not the current date.
risks.claim: Capital spending, buybacks and growth in working capital all draw on cash, and cash on hand is small. Capital expenditures are guided to approximately $800 million for fiscal 2026. Buybacks also consumed cash while revolver borrowings were used in the period. Leverage is currently low, so this is a modest risk.
quotes: Capital expenditures of approximately $800 million
we had $1.04 billion of unused capacity under our ABL Revolving Facility

risks.basis: stated in the 10-K risk factor; no recent regional data appears in the evidence.
risks.claim: Performance depends on the New York metropolitan area, which accounted for 23% of fiscal 2025 net sales. A regional slowdown, weather event or cost increase there could weigh on results.
quotes: Our financial and operational performance is dependent on our operations in the New York metropolitan area, which accounted for 23% of net sales in fiscal year 2025.
